```yaml
name: Stale issue and PR automation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 1 * * *'  # 1:30 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Mark stale issues and PRs
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          days-before-stale: 90
          days-before-close: 60
          stale-issue-label: stale
          stale-pr-label: stale
          stale-issue-message: |
            👋 Hi there! This issue has been inactive for a while and has been marked as **stale**. If you still need help or want to keep it active, please add a comment or a label. Otherwise, it will be closed in 60 days.
          stale-pr-message: |
            👋 Hi there! This pull request has been inactive for a while and has been marked as **stale**. If you still need help or want to keep it active, please add a comment or a label. Otherwise, it will be closed in 60 days.
          close-issue-message: |
            🚫 This issue has been closed because it remained stale for 60 days. If you still need assistance, feel free to reopen or create a new issue.
          close-pr-message: |
            🚫 This pull request has been closed because it remained stale for 60 days. If you still need assistance, feel free to reopen or create a new pull request.
          exempt-issue-labels: lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned
          exempt-pr-labels: lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned
          exempt-issue-assignees: true
          exempt-pr-assignees: true
          exempt-issue-milestones: true
          exempt-pr-milestones: true
          remove-issue-stale-when-updated: true
          remove-pr-stale-when-updated: true
```
